title: SOP-1: WAF Managed Rules changes deploy globally in one step

nodes.label: Decision

props.title: WAF Managed Rules changes deploy globally in one step, with no staged rollout
props.risk: The SOP allowed a non-emergency rule change to go globally into production without a staged rollout.

nodes.quote: The SOP for a rule change specifically allows it to be pushed globally.

links.quote: But, by design, the WAF doesn't use this process because of the need to respond rapidly to threats.
deployed using our Quicksilver distributed key-value (KV) store that can push changes globally in seconds
